name: Baatsun Pill
description: A small deep-green pill near the bottom centre of the screen that shows Baatsun's dictation state: five resting dots when idle; level bars that follow your voice, plus a tag for where the text will land, while listening; a spinner while transcribing; and a brief “✓ Pasted” or “Too short” afterwards. Hover it for a start/stop button. Stays above every window, including fullscreen ones, and never takes keyboard focus.
